name: Metapod

name: Cacnea

name: Tropius
flavour_text: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Petilil

1.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Vulpix

1.name: Hold Still
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales

1.name: Ember Dance

name: Goldeen

name: Seaking

1.name: Aqua Bullet

name: Feebas
flavour_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

flavour_text: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Luvdisc

name: Piplup

name: Pikachu

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Emolga

1.effect: Reveal all of your Pokémon in play and in your hand that have the Puppy Pile attack, and this attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon you revealed in this way.

name: Slowpoke

1.name: Growl
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.

flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Slowbro

1.name: Psybeam
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Munna
flavour_text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
flavour_text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Sylveon

ability.name: Soothing Ribbon
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.

name: Carbink

1.name: Glittering Gift
1.effect: Choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, take a [P] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each [P] Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

name: Enamorus

1.name: Smitten Strike
1.effect: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have 1 or more of the same type of Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Fidough

1.effect: Reveal all of your Pokémon in play and in your hand that have the Puppy Pile attack, and this attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon you revealed in this way.

name: Flutter Mane

1.name: Hexing Flight
1.effect: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Wooper

name: Rockruff

1.effect: Reveal all of your Pokémon in play and in your hand that have the Puppy Pile attack, and this attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon you revealed in this way.

name: Sandygast

name: Palossand

1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

name: Cacturne

name: Spiritomb

ability.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon takes −80 damage from that attack.

name: Jigglypuff

1.name: Stompy Stomp

1.name: Charm
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.
